title: Design: the filter chips keep their place as a picked chip changes
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access'.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Take a screenshot of the chips.
  3. Untick Part Sales in the Sales Type filter.
  4. Take a screenshot of the chips.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 2:

  • The first screenshot matches the chips of picture 20.2.

Step 3:

  • The chip reads Sales Type: Work Orders.

Step 4:

  • Compared with the first screenshot, the Date and Sales Type chips keep their place: nothing moves sideways or down.
  • The Sales Type chip still reads Sales Type: Work Orders.
